entities.summary: Greek physician (c. 460-370 BCE) known as the "Father of Medicine" for separating medical practice from religious superstition. The Hippocratic Corpus established clinical observation, prognosis, and ethical practice as foundations of medicine, while the Hippocratic Oath remains a touchstone of medical ethics today.
